categories.main_business_segments: The company focuses on integrated single-chip R&D, design, and sales in the mobile smart terminal field. Its main product lines include smart mobile terminal display driver chips (including TDDI integrated touch and display driver chips), camera voice coil motor (VCM) driver chips, fast charging protocol chips, and electronic shelf label (ESL) driver chips. These products serve applications in smartphones, tablets, smart speakers, wearables, fast charging/mobile power, smart retail, smart office, and smart healthcare.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced semiconductor design technologies including LCD DDIC, TDDI, and AMOLED DDIC for display drivers, with innovations such as dynamic brightness compensation, high refresh rate support, and integrated touch functions. It uses a fabless model outsourcing wafer manufacturing and packaging/testing to leading foundries and partners. Key technologies include TDDI algorithm replacing proximity sensors, multi-interface support (RGB, MIPI, LVDS, QSPI), and proprietary VCM motor driver algorithms for optical image stabilization. The company also develops fast charging protocol chips compliant with USB PD 3.1/3.2 and UFCS standards.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves major domestic and international customers including panel manufacturers (BOE, Innolux, CSOT), module makers, system integrators, and end brands such as Samsung, VIVO, OPPO, Honor, Amazon, Google, Baidu, Xiaomi, 360, TikTok, and others. Its products are widely used in smartphones, tablets, smart speakers, wearables, smart retail, and IoT devices. The company has stable relationships with key downstream customers and focuses on expanding market share through differentiated products.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters in Shenzhen and subsidiaries in Hong Kong and Hefei. Its sales cover domestic Chinese markets and international markets, with significant export revenue. The company’s Hong Kong subsidiary handles chip R&D, production, and sales with USD as the functional currency. The company’s products are sold globally, including to customers in the US and other regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates as a fabless semiconductor design firm, focusing on chip design, R&D, and sales. It outsources wafer fabrication, packaging, and testing to upstream foundries and packaging/testing service providers. It maintains strategic partnerships with leading domestic wafer and packaging suppliers to ensure stable and controllable production capacity. The company is positioned midstream in the semiconductor supply chain, specializing in chip design and integration.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technology and product innovation with continuous R&D investment (8.36% of revenue in 2024). It focuses on accelerating product iteration, developing differentiated new products, and expanding into new markets. Key R&D directions include high-integration, high-resolution display drivers, AMOLED driver ICs with power-saving and anti-burn-in algorithms, multi-color ESL driver chips, advanced fast charging protocol chips supporting USB PD 3.2 and UFCS, and closed-loop VCM motor drivers for optical image stabilization. The company also invests in AI algorithms for ESL optical optimization and plans to expand product portfolios in smart IoT applications.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through product sales of semiconductor chips, including display driver ICs, camera motor drivers, fast charging protocol chips, and ESL driver chips. Sales are conducted mainly through a distribution model with buyout agreements with distributors, supplemented by direct sales to key end customers. Revenue recognition occurs upon delivery and customer acceptance of products. The company also receives government subsidies and other operating income.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes in the semiconductor display driver and related chip markets against firms such as Jinghong Semiconductor and Jingmen Technology in the ESL segment. It holds a leading global market share in four-color ESL driver chips. In display driver ICs, it competes with domestic and international players, leveraging technology innovation and integration to gain market share. The company is recognized as a national specialized and innovative 'Little Giant' and manufacturing 'Single Champion' enterprise, indicating strong industry positioning.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved revenue of approximately RMB 2.1 billion, a 73.88% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 274.88 million, a 143.61% increase. The company’s net assets reached RMB 2.18 billion, up 11.79% from the prior year. R&D expenses increased by 22.20% to RMB 175.75 million. The company’s earnings per share rose to RMB 0.68 basic and RMB 0.67 diluted. The company shows a strong growth trajectory driven by expanding product demand and market penetration.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes differentiated, high-performance, and integrated chip solutions tailored for mobile smart terminals and IoT applications. Its products feature advanced technologies such as integrated touch and display drivers (TDDI), dynamic brightness compensation for AMOLED displays, multi-interface compatibility, and proprietary algorithms for optical image stabilization. The company’s ESL chips lead the market in multi-color display capability and low power consumption. Its fabless model with strong local supply chain partnerships ensures timely delivery and cost control. The company’s commitment to innovation, quality, and customer service underpins its competitive advantage.
